page.overview:
Who is Dr. Borville?

When falls ill on the way to , refuses to treat the child, stating it is beyond his expertise to do so.

When threatened with the , he admits the was stolen from him. He immediately contradicts himself by telling to return the to . If brings news of 's recovery later on, he is startled by that too, but then claims to have predicted it from the beginning.

Unlike the other residents of , does not react to . This may be due to his poor eyesight.
